claim_gate: Declare counts, primary and worst-group metrics and costs before judging. On each task require >=0.01 macro-F1 or >=1% lower RMSE than both a shared-tool fixed control and the mature adaptation, and no more than 0.02 worst-class recall loss or 1% worst-device RMSE increase relative to either. Keep same-budget shared-tool and unshared-tool differences separate. Full-system superiority requires all tasks and a complete mature comparison on genuinely withheld data.
